description.value:
The Qus are a race of strange, swamp-dwelling humanoids reputed for their huge appetites and cooking talent, following the Way of the Gourmand.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Qus gain +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and –2 Charisma.
  • Type: Qus are humanoids with the qu subtype.
  • Size: Qus are Medium creatures.
  • Base Speed: Qus have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Qus begin play speaking Common and Queran. Qus with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Strong Stomach: Qus gain a +4 racial bonus to saving throws against poison and sap status effects.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Expert Chefs: Qus gain a +2 racial bonus to Profession (Chef) skill checks.
  • Great Lungs: Qus receive Endurance for free at first level.
  • Local Quisine: Qus gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (Nature) and Knowledge (Local) checks, treated as class skills.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Weapon Familiarity: Qus are proficient with the chef weapons group and the Qu Battle Fork.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Scent: Qus gain the scent ability.
